subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Independence went the war. No nation took place to the battle field to save the country. Our War of Liberation be it without struggle. People of all walks of life can achieve in 1971. They joined the birth right of a nation.
guide_solution: (a) Independence is the birth right of a nation. (b) No nation can achieve it without struggle. (c) Our War of Liberation took place in 1971. (d) People from all walks of life joined the war. (e) They went to the battle field to save the country.
